name: @pipeworx/mcp-imf

tools.name: get_datasets
tools.description: List or search the IMF's datasets — CPI, WEO (World Economic Outlook), BOP (Balance of Payments), IMTS (trade in goods), GFS (government finance), MFS (monetary and financial), FSI (financial soundness), commodity prices and ~200 more. Returns the dataset id to pass to get_data and search_indicators, plus its name and description. Pass `query` to filter by name, e.g. "inflation", "trade", "government".

query.description: Optional filter matched against dataset id, name and description (e.g. "inflation", "trade").

tools.name: get_data
tools.description: Fetch an IMF time series. Identify the series by dataset plus a `dimensions` map of named codes, e.g. get_data({dataset:"CPI", dimensions:{COUNTRY:"USA", INDEX_TYPE:"CPI", COICOP_1999:"_T", TYPE_OF_TRANSFORMATION:"IX", FREQUENCY:"M"}, start:"2024-01"}). Dimension names and order differ per dataset — use search_indicators to see what a dataset accepts. Any dimension you omit is left open, returning every code for it. Returns observations as {period, value} plus the dimension values of each series.

dimensions.description: Map of dimension code to value, e.g. {"COUNTRY":"USA","FREQUENCY":"M"}. A value may be a list to OR codes together: {"COUNTRY":["USA","GBR"]}. Omitted dimensions match everything. Use search_indicators to discover valid names and codes.

tools.name: search_indicators
tools.description: Discover what a dataset accepts: its dimension names in key order, and the codes available for each, filtered by `query`. Use this before get_data — e.g. search_indicators({dataset:"CPI", query:"united states"}) finds COUNTRY=USA. Without a query it returns the dimension list and a sample of codes.

query.description: Optional term matched against code ids and names, e.g. "united states", "GDP", "monthly".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-imf forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the imf pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
